safety.sourceAdaptations: Only exact known origin guards allow loopback fixtures. Publication trust and revision checks remain unchanged.

notes: Browser runs prove correctness on the recorded fixture suites. They are not performance benchmarks.
Case executions are not a count of distinct articles.
Earlier candidate reports and partial Safari diagnostics are excluded.

isolated.method: Fresh directory contains only explicitly approved tests, controller source and five frozen distributions. Commands run from its repository root.
